brief: Write three static Meta ad copy variants for a parent whose child is starting to explore cupboards. Help them consider the kit as part of preparing their home. This is a hypothetical audience scenario, not customer research. Do not imply any lock fits every cupboard or that the kit replaces supervision.

variants.primary_text: When little hands start exploring cupboards, it may be time to think about how your home is set up. The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes cabinet/fridge locks, plus edge and corner protectors, socket guards and door guards for Indian homes. Get 1-to-1 installation video support, and remember that childproofing is part of preparation—not a replacement for adult supervision.
